full_details: In the morning you wrote Augustine's pointing. The spring note as in the book. The winter note as in the book. You did not copy the verses, and you did not better them. You ate little, and went down to the old Hamlet. You were under the stage in a sheet and flour. The horses coughed in the stable behind you. You cried the line. In the parlour Kemp said you were more fearful a fortnight ago, with the cold. Sincler asked how a man stands so as to look dead. You told him to think of the reckoning. Richard had the gallery of lawyers from the stage. You had the horses, not the faces. The Rose has the second Tamburlaine. You did not go.
one_sentence: You pointed the two songs, and under the stage you cried the old ghost's line in the last of the light.
title: Cried under the stage, and told Sincler the reckoning
